blurb: Escape Artists offers immersive escape room games where teams of 2 to 7 work together to solve puzzles and complete missions within a set time. All rooms are private, ensuring only you and your group play. Games are designed for a wide range of audiences, including families, friends, and corporate teams. The facility features multiple themed rooms with varying puzzles and challenges.
extraNote: Last-minute changes or absences can’t be transferred or refunded; call or email as soon as possible if you need to reschedule. · No refunds or rescheduling options for cancellations or no-shows. · Arrive 10-15 minutes before the game to ensure a prompt start. · If you’re late, you might not get the full game experience. · Payments are made online at the time of booking.
